items.name: Nour's Parent
items.quote: Nour feels happy, safe and inspired to learn, Cute kids academy is her second home 🥰

A second home, not just a school... From the very first day my daughter joined Cute Kids Academy, I knew we had made the right choice. It wasn't just a place for learning — it became her second home. A space where she laughed, learned, grew, and truly blossomed. Cute Kids Academy played a huge role in shaping her personality, supporting us in raising her with care, kindness, and confidence. So many precious memories were made — ones we'll carry with us forever.
The best nursery ever in everything raising up the kids, education, hygiene and healthcare.
Thank you for creating such a nurturing space where she has grown, learned, and shined everyday

The best nursery ever, I tried many nurseries for his elder brother and sister but my experience in Cute Kids was so much different.... my son loved them and I felt we were one family for the whole 3 years he spent there

A healthy community to leave our kids, loveable teachers, friendly helpful kind assistants and kids enjoy their time there. Kids eat well, learn well, play, sing, dance and they know a lot of things from the nursery. Generally there's a charm and harmony to the place and the people together there
He has become more confident, social and independent. Second home ❤
